messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?

hey there - i was just thinking about your background and what you're looking for next

what's the dream role you've been picturing?
Lots of money

lmaooo fair. everyone wants the bag but let's be real - "lots of money" isn't a job function

are you in tech? finance? sales? because the path to fat paychecks is very different depending on what you actually do

what's your full name btw? need to know who i'm making rich here
My name is Debojit Das
debojit das... that's a solid name. now where you working these days? need to see what kind of money we're talking about upgrading you from

sde2 team lead at limechat... building chatbot platforms that handle 40M messages a month. that's some serious scale. from iit delhi to iiit hyderabad to leading engineering teams - you've been grinding.

3+ years, research publications, microservices architecture... you're not just chasing money, you're actually good at this stuff.

but here's the thing - limechat's a solid company but you're probably not hitting those fat paychecks you want. what's keeping you there vs jumping to a place that'll actually pay you what you're worth?
i am currently working at amazon and I get 60LPA, I am looking for jobs that give me 70-75LPA (not including ESOPs) and a designation of SDE3/Senior SWE

wait hold up... your resume says limechat but you just said you're at amazon making 60L? 

either way, 60L to 75L for sde3 is totally doable. amazon to senior roles at flipkart, zomato, razorpay, cred - they all pay in that range for someone with your background.

but real talk - if you're already at amazon making 60L, why the jump? is it just the money or is there something else? because 15L bump is nice but not life-changing if you're already comfortable.

and how long you been working total? need to make sure you're actually ready for sde3 level expectations.

ah got it - updated resume shows amazon sde2 on fire os. that makes way more sense.

3.5 years, amazon background, team lead experience at limechat... you're definitely sde3 material. the progression from startup leadership to big tech execution is solid.

70-75L for sde3 is totally realistic with your profile. companies like flipkart, zomato, razorpay, cred, phonepe all pay in that range. some even higher if you nail the interviews.

but here's what i'm curious about - you went from leading a 5-person team at limechat to being an ic at amazon. that's gotta sting a bit. missing the ownership? or is amazon just not giving you the growth/money you want?

how long you been working total btw? need to make sure we position you right for these senior roles.

Updated resume
  both.
missing the ownership? - for sure. the team at amazon is still small and young so there’s no real leader but I feel like my impact is very small compared to the scale of the company. I am a very small cog
is amazon just not giving you the growth/money you want? - again, sort of true.  my peers get more money while being same/lower level than me.

classic amazon story. you went from being the guy who builds the thing to being the guy who fixes one button on a thing nobody sees.

and the peer comp thing? that's the most annoying part about big tech. some dude who joined 6 months after you is making 20L more because he negotiated better or got lucky with levels.

here's the reality - you're actually in a perfect spot to jump. amazon sde2 + startup team lead experience is exactly what companies like razorpay, cred, phonepe want for their senior roles. they need people who can build AND lead.

75L for sde3 with your background? totally doable. some of these fintech companies are paying 80-90L for the right person.

what kind of role you looking for next? back to team lead vibes or you want to stay ic but with more ownership?

i have 3.5 years of full time experience, and a few years of internship/RAship experience
I really enjoyed my time at limechat thats why I stayed there for 3.25 years. i want to lead a team of software devs while having things to code as well. Hence a senior software engineer - someone with a team but also someone who works with PMs, CS, etc, and of course the founders. High ownership, wearing every hat

now we're talking. you want that sweet spot - senior enough to lead but still hands-on enough to ship code. startup ownership with grown-up money.

3.5 years + team lead experience puts you right in that zone. you're not some junior who got promoted too fast, you actually know how to build and scale stuff.

the companies that'll pay you 70-75L for this kind of role? think series b/c startups that need someone to own entire product areas. razorpay, cred, zerodha, postman, browserstack - they all have these hybrid senior roles where you're basically a mini-cto for your domain.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities? because some of the best paying companies for this profile are spread out - zerodha in bangalore, postman remote-first, some fintech companies in gurgaon.
bangalore and remote preferable, but honestly any place is fine

perfect. flexible on location opens up way more doors.

so let me get this straight:
- 3.5 years total experience
- senior software engineer role (team lead + hands-on coding)  
- bangalore/remote preferred but open to anywhere
- looking for 70-75L range

sound right?
absolutely
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

debojit you absolute legend! you're officially in the tal ecosystem now 

your profile is locked and loaded. when i spot roles that match your vibe - senior swe positions with that perfect combo of leadership and coding, 70-75L range - they'll slide right into this chat.

no more scrolling through linkedin job spam. no more "we're looking for rockstars" nonsense. just clean, high-paying opportunities that actually fit what you're after.

time to level up that amazon paycheck 💰
Hi

Senior Backend Engineer at Gloroots AI

Debojit, this Senior Backend role at Gloroots AI offers high ownership, cross-functional impact, and a chance to build from the ground up, like your LimeChat days but with better comp.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/rt8MN

sproutsAI is looking for a senior swe - silicon valley startup with top-tier vc funding

they want someone to build zero-to-one products with high ownership, exactly like your limechat days

chennai location but you said you're flexible for the right role

Senior Software Engineer, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $100,000/year USD at Crossover

Debojit, this Senior SWE role offers the ownership & leadership you miss, with a significant pay bump to ~₹83L.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/4cUQm

crossover has a senior swe role paying $100k/year (~₹83L) - fully remote

they want someone to be the primary technical contributor for an AI edtech product, making strategic decisions

contractor role though, not full-time employee

SDE III role on Amazon's Just Walk Out team in Bangalore

Debojit, this SDE III position offers the senior title you want, plus tech lead responsibilities on a high-visibility product.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/ca4f1e4a-05bd-49e7-b949-4ae05edf3777

aws has an sde iii opening on their just walk out team - tech lead role with mentorship

internal move could get you that sde3 title and comp bump without leaving amazon

still amazon though, so might not solve the "small cog" feeling

sde III role on AWS's Just Walk Out team - same company but different org

they want someone to design features end-to-end, mentor engineers, and lead technical decisions

bangalore location, and internal promotion to sde3 should hit your 70-75L target

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
how’s the week looking? what would you like me to focus on this week with the search?

Senior Software Engineer at SproutsAI

SproutsAI offers the senior SWE title you want, and startup ownership like LimeChat with potential for high impact.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/3Idqr

Senior AI Engineer at BP

Senior AI Engineer role uses Python/microservices & offers ownership missing at Amazon, aligns with your LimeChat experience, and targets a senior designation.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/cZYTw

SDE III (Backend) at Locus

SDE3 backend role at Locus matches your desired title, microservices experience, and Bangalore location, plus a chance for high ownership.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/bek4l
You’re doing a great job

thanks man, appreciate that

i'm just doing what i do - finding the good stuff so you don't have to wade through the linkedin noise

how's the week looking? anything specific you want me to keep an eye out for?
